The connector's linear layer is float32 but the input is bfloat16. The connector needs to be cast too. But in the clean forward (with autocast), this works because autocast handles it. In the perturbed path, we're running without autocast inside `torch.no_grad()`.

Let me also check: vision encoder output is [2, 256, 768]. The connector does pixel_shuffle (scale_factor=2) → 256/4 = 64 tokens, then projection 768×4=3072 → 960. So connector output should be [2, 64, 960].

The issue is:
1. The clean path uses `torch.autocast` which auto-casts the connector's float32 weights
2. The perturbed path runs under `torch.no_grad()` without autocast, so dtype mismatch

And there might be another issue: 48 tokens in perturbed = something wrong with vision encoder output when input size differs.

Let me fix the dtype issue and add autocast to the perturbed path:

def _score_perturbed(self, batch: dict[str, torch.Tensor]) -> torch.Tensor:
        image_keys = sorted(
            k for k in batch
            if k.startswith("observation.images.") and isinstance(batch[k], torch.Tensor)
            and batch[k].dim() == 4
        )
        if not image_keys:
            return None

        prev = self.acib_enabled
        self.acib_enabled = False
        all_logits = []
        try:
            for key in image_keys:
                img = batch[key]
                if torch.rand(1).item() < 0.75:
                    perturbed = self._perturb_transform(img)
                else:
                    perturbed = img + torch.randn_like(img) * 0.1
                with torch.no_grad():
                    vis_out = self._vision_encoder(perturbed.to(self._connector.modality_projection.proj.weight.dtype))
                    raw_tokens = vis_out.last_hidden_state if hasattr(vis_out, "last_hidden_state") else vis_out[0]
                    tokens = self._connector(raw_tokens)
                condition = tokens.mean(dim=1)
                _, logits = self.scorer(tokens, condition)
                all_logits.append(logits)
        finally:
            self.acib_enabled = prev
        return torch.cat(all_logits, dim=1) if all_logits else None

export http_proxy=http://10.37.1.23:12798
export https_proxy=http://10.37.1.23:12798

BASE="https://huggingface.co/datasets/HuggingFaceVLA/libero/resolve/main"

curl -L --proxy http://10.37.1.23:12798 --cacert /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt \
  --retry 3 --max-time 300 -o "$DEST/data/chunk-000/file-000.parquet" \
  "$BASE/data/chunk-000/file-000.parquet" 2>&1
echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) file-000: $(stat -c%s "$DEST/data/chunk-000/file-000.parquet" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) bytes"

# If first file works, download the rest
size=$(stat -c%s "$DEST/data/chunk-000/file-000.parquet" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
if [ "$size" -gt 1000000 ]; then
  echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) Proxy works! Downloading remaining files..."
  downloaded=1
  failed=0
  for i in $(seq 1 378); do
    chunk=$((i / 1000))
    chunk_str=$(printf "%03d" $chunk)
    file_str=$(printf "%03d" $i)
    url="$BASE/data/chunk-${chunk_str}/file-${file_str}.parquet"
    dest_file="$DEST/data/chunk-${chunk_str}/file-${file_str}.parquet"
    mkdir -p "$(dirname "$dest_file")"

    if [ -f "$dest_file" ] && [ $(stat -c%s "$dest_file") -gt 1000000 ]; then
      downloaded=$((downloaded + 1))
      continue
    fi

    curl -sL --proxy http://10.37.1.23:12798 --cacert /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt \
      --retry 3 --max-time 300 -o "$dest_file" "$url"
    fsize=$(stat -c%s "$dest_file" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
    if [ "$fsize" -gt 1000000 ]; then
      downloaded=$((downloaded + 1))
    else
      failed=$((failed + 1))
      echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) FAILED: file-${file_str} ($fsize bytes)"
    fi

    if [ $((downloaded % 20)) -eq 0 ]; then
      echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) Progress: $downloaded/$((i+1)) downloaded, $failed failed"
    fi
  done
  echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) DONE: $downloaded downloaded, $failed failed"
else
  echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) Proxy download failed (only $size bytes), falling back to hf-mirror..."
fi
du -sh "$DEST"
echo "LIBERO_DONE"
' > /tmp/dl_libero_proxy.log 2>&1 &
echo "PID=$!"

#!/bin/bash
export http_proxy=http://10.37.1.23:12798
export https_proxy=http://10.37.1.23:12798

DEST="/root/autodl-tmp/libero_dataset"
BASE="https://huggingface.co/datasets/HuggingFaceVLA/libero/resolve/main"
mkdir -p "$DEST/data/chunk-000" "$DEST/meta"

download_one() {
  local i=$1
  local file_str=$(printf "%03d" $i)
  local url="$BASE/data/chunk-000/file-${file_str}.parquet"
  local dest_file="$DEST/data/chunk-000/file-${file_str}.parquet"

  if [ -f "$dest_file" ] && [ $(stat -c%s "$dest_file") -gt 1000000 ]; then
    echo "SKIP $file_str"
    return 0
  fi

  curl -sL --proxy http://10.37.1.23:12798 --cacert /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt \
    --retry 3 --max-time 600 -o "$dest_file" "$url"
  local fsize=$(stat -c%s "$dest_file" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
  if [ "$fsize" -gt 1000000 ]; then
    echo "OK $file_str ($fsize bytes)"
  else
    echo "FAIL $file_str ($fsize bytes)"
    rm -f "$dest_file"
    return 1
  fi
}
export -f download_one
export DEST BASE

# Download meta files first
for f in meta/info.json meta/stats.json README.md; do
  if [ ! -f "$DEST/$f" ] || [ $(stat -c%s "$DEST/$f" 2>/dev/null) -lt 100 ]; then
    curl -sL --proxy http://10.37.1.23:12798 --cacert /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt \
      --max-time 60 -o "$DEST/$f" "$BASE/$f"
  fi
done

echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) Starting parallel download of 377 parquet files (10 concurrent)..."
seq 0 376 | xargs -P10 -I{} bash -c 'download_one {}'
echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) Download complete!"
ls -1 "$DEST/data/chunk-000/" | wc -l
du -sh "$DEST"
echo "LIBERO_PARALLEL_DONE"
SCRIPT
chmod +x /root/download_libero.sh
nohup /root/download_libero.sh > /tmp/dl_libero_par.log 2>&1 &
echo "PID=$!"
